subject: delta(client): WF add the read-only qualification observer source over a bound node owner and re-export its check to the seller kit
note: The node-wallet entry adds createQualificationObserverSource({owner, binding, clock}) and isQualificationObserverSource(source, {binding, currentLocal, observer}). The constructor takes only an owner createNodeTransportOwner made, admits the TP-1 binding on its connection through admitTp1Authority, and resolves a frozen {observer, source, currentLocal}: the read-only node observer over that owner, the owner's currentLocal, and a frozen declaration of the three publications under the admitted token's label, registered with that binding, currentLocal and observer. It loads no key, opens no wallet or journal, takes no lock and sends no write, so it works while purchase actions are held. The README describes both exports; the public API test lists them; the seller kit re-exports the check from devnet-source.mjs and classifies it as pure. No core file changes, so HOLD.json is not re-pinned, and package.json is unchanged.
